cache_read.script:
local kind=redis.call('TYPE',KEYS[1]).ok
if kind~='none' and kind~='string' then return {-1,false} end
if redis.call('STRLEN',KEYS[1])>1048576 then return {-2,false} end
local value=redis.call('GET',KEYS[1])
if not value then return {0,false} end
return {1,value}

result_write.script:
local t=redis.call('TYPE',KEYS[1]).ok
if t~='none'and t~='string'then return -1 end
if #ARGV[1]>262144 then return -1 end
if t=='string'then
 if redis.call('STRLEN',KEYS[1])>262144 then return -1 end
 local ok,old=pcall(cjson.decode,redis.call('GET',KEYS[1]))
 if not ok or type(old)~='table'then return -1 end
 if old.status=='SUCCESS'then return 0 end
end
redis.call('SETEX',KEYS[1],3600,ARGV[1]);redis.call('PUBLISH',KEYS[1],ARGV[1]);return 1

channels_publish.script:
for _,key in ipairs(KEYS) do local t=redis.call('TYPE',key).ok;if t~='none' and t~='zset' then return redis.error_reply('CORRUPT channel type') end end
local dropped=0;for index,key in ipairs(KEYS) do
 redis.call('ZREMRANGEBYSCORE',key,0,tonumber(ARGV[1])-60)
 if redis.call('ZCARD',key)<tonumber(ARGV[2]) then redis.call('ZADD',key,ARGV[1],ARGV[index+2]);redis.call('EXPIRE',key,60) else dropped=dropped+1 end
end;return dropped
